unit.description: Measurement unit for every coordinate and size passed to the document

format.type: string | [number, number] | { width: number; height: number }
format.description: Page size preset name (a0-a8, b3-b6, c3-c6, letter, legal, tabloid, ledger, executive, folio, statement, creditcard) or explicit dimensions

orientation.description: Page orientation applied to the default page size

margin.type: number | number[] | { top, right, bottom, left }
margin.description: Page margin used as the default content area for every page

metadata.description: Title, author, subject, keywords, creator and dates written to the document information dictionary

defaultFont.description: Font family used until setFont is called

defaultFontSize.description: Font size used until setFontSize is called

lineHeightFactor.description: Multiplier applied to the font size to derive line height

language.description: Document language tag exposed to assistive technology

font.description: Font family for this call, falling back to the document font

bold.description: Select the bold face of the family

italic.description: Select the italic or oblique face of the family

color.description: Text colour as a hex string, CSS colour function, named colour, packed integer or channel array

align.description: Horizontal alignment within the measure defined by maxWidth

anchor.description: Whether x is the left edge of an alignment box or the alignment point itself

maxWidth.description: Wrap the text to this measure

maxLines.description: Truncate after this many lines and append the ellipsis marker

ellipsis.description: Marker appended when text is truncated

lineHeightFactor.description: Line height multiplier for this call

wordSpacing.description: Extra space inserted at each space character

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees about the text origin

baseline.description: Which part of the glyph box the y coordinate refers to

underline.description: Draw a rule beneath each line

strikeThrough.description: Draw a rule through each line

fillColor.description: Interior colour; omit to leave the shape unfilled

strokeColor.description: Outline colour; omit to leave the shape unstroked

lineCap.description: How open path ends are drawn

lineJoin.description: How corners between segments are drawn

opacity.description: Opacity applied to both fill and stroke

columns.description: Column keys, headers, widths and per-column styles; inferred from the data when omitted

head.description: Header rows; derived from the column headers when omitted

body.description: Body rows as arrays or as objects keyed by column key

foot.description: Footer rows; derived from the column footers when omitted

preset.description: Built-in visual treatment for the table

palette.description: Colour overrides layered on top of the chosen preset

styles.description: Style overrides for all cells, a section, the stripe rows, or named columns

startY.description: Vertical position where the table begins; defaults to the top margin

margin.description: Margin used to compute the available width and page break threshold

align.description: Horizontal placement of the table within the content area

repeat.description: Whether header and footer rows repeat when the table spans pages

minRowHeight.description: Minimum height applied to every row

outerBorderWidth.description: Width of a border drawn around the whole table

onCellBeforeDraw.description: Called before each cell is painted; mutate the style or return false to skip the cell

onCellAfterDraw.description: Called after each cell is painted, for drawing decorations over it

onPageStart.description: Called when the table starts laying out on a page

onPageEnd.description: Called when the table finishes on a page

includeHidden.description: Include rows and cells whose computed style hides them

inheritStyles.description: Carry the table's computed CSS into the generated document

ignoreColors.description: When inheriting styles, keep the spacing, alignment and borders but leave the page's colours behind so the table prints in the preset's palette

view.description: Window used to resolve computed styles; defaults to the table's own view

skipColumns.description: Column indices to leave out of the export

includeRow.description: Return false to leave a row out of the export

includeCell.description: Return false to leave a cell out of the export

transformText.description: Rewrite each cell's text before it is measured

key.description: Identifies the column; object rows are read by this key and array rows by position

header.description: Header cell content when no explicit head rows are supplied

footer.description: Footer cell content when no explicit foot rows are supplied

width.description: Fixed width in document units, or let the solver size the column from its content

minWidth.description: Lower bound the solver may not shrink past

maxWidth.description: Upper bound the solver may not grow past

style.description: Styles for the whole column — header, body and footer cells alike. Set align here to align a column's header with its values

headerStyle.description: Overrides layered on top of style for this column's header cells only

footerStyle.description: Overrides layered on top of style for this column's footer cells only

format.description: Formats each body value before it is measured and drawn
